WITH rating_prices AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
with_overall_mean AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    avg_replacement_cost,
    per_day_price,
    AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS overall_mean_per_day_price
  FROM rating_prices
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  per_day_price,
  per_day_price / NULLIF(overall_mean_per_day_price, 0) AS relative_per_day_price
FROM with_overall_mean
WHERE overall_mean_per_day_price IS NOT NULL
